correctness.rationale: The exact rational Schwarz map ω=z(1−3z+8z²)/(8−3z+z²) factors into z times two disk Blaschke factors whose conjugate zeros have squared modulus 1/8. With Q=φ_H∘ω, the odd g=z exp ∫(Q_even−1)/z and even h=∫Q_odd g/z construct analytic f=g+h on the entire disk, f(0)=0 and f′(0)=1; 2zf′/(f−f(−z))=Q follows identically. Positivity Re φ_H>0 makes g odd starlike (Re zg′/g=Re Q_even>0), with f close-to-convex relative to g and therefore univalent if required by the ambient class definition. Independent exact Fraction division and Hankel evaluation reproduce (a2,a3,a4,a5)=(1/16,−31/192,3749/18432,19373/147456), H=−10700387/169869312 and positive gaps 83555/169869312 and 69731/169869312. Polynomial finite checks verify the digits, while Blaschke/integral identities establish global analytic membership.
residual_risks: This is a counterexample lower bound; it does not give a sharp supremum or extremizers.
Class definition must use the exact symmetric-point normalized logarithmic derivative, as compared to the two cited primary works.

Neither wrong universal bound implies this counterexample; the checked citation snippets are not a whole-text search for an already existing correction. Direct searches of its rational fraction and Blaschke form revealed no prior indexed instance. Therefore best-of-knowledge originality is qualified, not categorical.
